span.normalized: All discussion within this Form 10-K, including amounts, percentages and disclosures for all periods presented, reflect only our continuing operations unless otherwise noted. In connection with the Separation, we entered into several agreements with Worthington Steel that govern our ongoing relationships, including a Trademark License Agreement, both a short-term and long-term Transition Services Agreement, and a Steel Supply and Services Agreement. Transactions governed by these agreements are considered to be related party transactions.
